definitions.interval: One per signed command or review that wrote a hash-chained audit row for a study of this family: from the client's stated work start to the signature. Without a stated start the action is counted with no duration.
definitions.active: The union of one actor's intervals, so overlapping work is counted once.
definitions.window: A milestone measurement interval; an actor's active time is clipped to the window, within the window's scope (the whole family for platform and root-scope windows, the site for a site-scoped contract or IRB). Windows overlap and are not additive.
definitions.statedSeconds: The plain sum of an actor's stated intervals, before overlap is removed.

limitations: Work start is stated by the client; the server bounds it (at most 12 hours before, never after, the signature) but cannot observe work outside the EDC.
Only signed commands and reviews are captured; unsigned edits, reading time and work in other systems are not.
Engineering evidence of effort recorded by this EDC, not a determination of total human hours per milestone.
